newsitem.title: TAIWAN: TAIWAN STOCKS END DOWN 2.57 PCT ON WALL STREET.
newsitem.headline: TAIWAN STOCKS END DOWN 2.57 PCT ON WALL STREET.

text.p: Heavy late selling triggered by overnight losses in Wall Street and Nasdaq reversed Taiwan share prices' early rebound to a sharply lower close on Wednesday, brokers said.

The weighted index opened higher in a technical rebound, but heavy selling in the last 10 minutes on electronics sent the index down to as low as 9,547.80 points. It closed at 9,556.12, a loss of 251.62 points or 2.57 percent, marking the three straight days of declines.
Turnover was active at T$158.6 billion.
Late selling focused on electronics, falling 3.50 percent.

Microchip giant Taiwan Semiconductor was down by the daily seven percent limit to T$142.5 after Philips Taiwan, a fully-owned subsidiary of Philips Electronics NV, said on Tuesday it would auction 100 million shares of Taiwan Semiconductor on August 18.
Computer giant Acer was also limit down to T$85.
"The technical rebound failed to sustain as Wall Street's and Nasdaq's overnight sharp losses further dampened confidence," said HSBC James Capel research manager Alex Chen.
Constructions, which had surged recently to replace electronics as the bellwether sector, plunged 4.3 percent, with BES Engineering limit down to T$38.6.

"Institutional investors have tried to promote constructions to be the new trend-setting sector, but general investors still could not accept this as the sector's fundamentals have not shown apparent improvement," Chen said.
"Electronics will continue to be the bellwehter sector."
Tourism shares rose 0.28 percent after the cabinet passed a plan to implement five-day work week every other week from 1998.
Brokers said the index likely will launch a rebound on Thursday after three straight days of sharp falls.
"The domestic economic recovery is pretty sound and the government is still pretty bullish. Unless Wall Street falls sharply again, Thursday's index likely will rebound," Chen said.
For Thursday, a 9,500-9,800 range was seen.
